name: CITY COUNCIL MEETING
agenda_text:
CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
September 28, 2021 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
INVOCATION: Deacon Paul Machuca, Beatitudes of Our Lord Catholic Church
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
ROLL CALL:
Councilmember De Ruse
Councilmember Lewis
Councilmember Sarega
Mayor Pro Tem Otero
Mayor Eng
5.
APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.1
PRESENTATION BY LOS ANGELES COUNTY ASSESSOR JEFF PRANG - It is recommended the City Council receive a presentation by Los Angeles County Assessor Jeff Prang.
5.1 Presentation by LAC Assessor
5.2
INTRODUCTION OF NEW FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES - It is recommended the City Council welcome Valeria Andrade, Amelia Lindqvist, Derek Saucedo, and Brandon Pong, and present them with a $40.00 gift certificate to Polly's Pie Restaurant, a voucher for two tickets to the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts, and two passes to Splash! La Mirada Regional Aquatics Center.
5.2 Introduction of New City Employees
6.
PUBLIC COMMENT: (Any information or materials provided during Public Comments are recorded in the minutes and are subject to public disclosure under the Public Records Act. The speaker is requested, but is not required, to orally state his or her name and/or address for purposes of recording the information accurately in the minutes. If the speaker declines to provide his or her name, address, and other relevant information, the records will so indicate. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council.)
7.
APPOINTMENTS
7.1
APPOINTMENT TO THE PUBLIC SAFETY AND TRAFFIC COMMISSION – It is recommended the City Council appoint Angelo Maldonado to the Public Safety and Traffic Commission.
7.1 Appointment to the Public Safety & Traffic Commission
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR: (All items listed on the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine matters, status reports or subjects covered previously by the City Council. Items listed on the Consent Calendar may be enacted in one motion.)
8.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the Study Session meeting of September 14, 2021 and the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of September 14, 2021.
8.1 Minutes of 9-14-21 SS
8.1 Minutes of 9-14-21 CC
8.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated September 28, 2021 in the total amount of $1,052,295.68.
8.2 Warrant Register - City
8.3
AUTHORIZATION TO PURCHASE A SOUND BOARD - It is recommended the City Council authorize the purchase of a new sound board from Pacific Coast Entertainment at a cost not to exceed $85,262.04.
8.3 Theatre Sound Board
8.4
I-605 ARTERIAL HOT SPOTS IN LA MIRADA/SANTA FE SPRINGS, ROSECRANS AVENUE AND VALLEY VIEW AVENUE INTERSECTION IMPROVEMENT PROJECT – APPROVAL OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS - It is recommended the City Council approve the plans and specifications for the I-605 Arterial Hot Spots in La Mirada/Santa Fe Springs, Rosecrans Avenue and Valley View Avenue Intersection Improvement Project.
8.4 I-605 Arterial Hot Spots
8.5
PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH BLODGETT BAYLOSIS ENVIRONMENTAL PLANNING FOR THE PREPARATION OF THE CITY OF LA MIRADA GENERAL PLAN, HOUSING ELEMENT UPDATE FOR THE 6TH PLANNING CYCLE, 2021-2029 - It is recommended the City Council authorize the City Manager to execute a Professional Services Agreement with Blodgett Baylosis Environmental Planning for the preparation of the City of La Mirada General Plan, Housing Element Update for the 6th Planning Cycle, 2021-2029, including completion of a Housing Sites Survey and the associated Mitigated Negative Declaration environmental analysis (MND) in the amount of $96,050.00 and authorize the City Manager to approve additional work that may be required to complete the Housing Element Update in an amount not to exceed fifteen percent (15%) of the authorized proposal amount.
8.5 Agreement with Blodgett Baylosis
9.
PUBLIC HEARING
9.1
SECOND PUBLIC HEARING TO RECEIVE INPUT FROM THE COMMUNITY REGARDING THE REDRAWING OF ELECTION DISTRICT BOUNDARIES - It is recommended the City Council conduct a public hearing to receive input from the community regarding the redrawing of election district boundaries.
9.1 Public Hearing: Election District Boundaries
9.2
RESOLUTION NO. 21-30 APPROVING AN OPERATING COVENANT AGREEMENT AFFECTING INTEREST IN REAL PROPERTY BY AND BETWEEN THE CITY OF LA MIRADA AND LIVING SPACES FURNITURE, LLC AND LIVINGSPACES.COM - It is recommended the City Council conduct a public hearing as prescribed by law and, after conducting said public hearing, adopt Resolution No. 21-30 approving an Operating Covenant Agreement between the City of La Mirada and Living Spaces Furniture, LLC and Livingspaces.com and authorize the City Manager to execute the Agreement on behalf of the City.
9.2 Public Hearing: Resolution No. 21-30
10.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
10.1
RESOLUTION NO. 21-29 APPROVING THE INSTALLATION OF STOP SIGNS AND ACCOMPANYING STOP CONTROL PAVEMENT MARKINGS AT THE WEST APPROACHES OF NEARTREE ROAD, LA CAPELLE ROAD, AND BARWOOD DRIVE AT THEIR INTERSECTIONS WITH LA BARCA DRIVE – It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 21-29 approving the installation of Stop signs with accompanying STOP pavement markings at the west approaches of Neartree Road, La Capelle Road and Barwood Drive at their intersections with La Barca Drive.
10.1 Resolution No. 21-29
11.
ADMINISTRATIVE REPORT
11.1
UTILITY BOX ART CONTEST – It is recommended the City Council receive an update from staff on the proposed Utility Box Art Contest.
SUCCESSOR AGENCY
12.
CONSENT CALENDAR: (All items listed on the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine matters, status reports or subjects covered previously by the Successor Agency. Items listed on the Consent Calendar may be enacted in one motion.)
12.1
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the Successor Agency approve the warrant register dated September 28, 2021 in the total amount of $7,620.00.
12.1 Warrant Register - SA
